import openpyxl
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

src = '/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/08_Project Seafood Model/08_03_Seafood_input.xlsx'
out = '/mnt/spreadsheet_output/08_03_output.xlsx'

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(src, data_only=False)

# 1) Balance Sheet: Share capital monthly I7:CB7 <- Equity Schedule closing balance row 138
#    Capex sheet cols D.. start Aug-21 ; Jan-23 = col U(21) ; I(9) -> 21, offset +12
bs = wb['Balance Sheet']
for c in range(9, 81):  # I..CB
    src_col = c + 12    # I(9)->U(21) ... CB(80)->CN(92)
    bs.cell(row=7, column=c).value = "='Capex and Debt Assumptions '!%s138" % get_column_letter(src_col)

# 2) Income Statement: Net Margin C69:H69 = Net Income / Revenue
inc = wb['Income Statement']
for c in range(3, 9):  # C..H
    L = get_column_letter(c)
    inc.cell(row=69, column=c).value = "=%s68/%s$6" % (L, L)

# 3) Ratio Analysis: Debt to Equity C19:H19 = (LTD + WC Loan)/Total Equity
ra = wb['Ratio Analysis']
for c in range(3, 9):
    L = get_column_letter(c)
    ra.cell(row=19, column=c).value = \
        "=('Balance Sheet'!%s18+'Balance Sheet'!%s13)/'Balance Sheet'!%s9" % (L, L, L)

# 4) Working Capital: row 44 Inventory - Finished Goods (all categories) J44:BV44
#    row 50 Total Current Assets J50:BV50 = Inventory + Receivables
wc = wb['Working Capital']
for c in range(10, 75):  # J..BV
    L = get_column_letter(c)
    wc.cell(row=44, column=c).value = "=%s6+%s15+%s26+%s35" % (L, L, L, L)
    wc.cell(row=50, column=c).value = "=%s46+%s47" % (L, L)

# 5) DCF Valuation: Terminal Value in K16 (Gordon growth on last year FCFE)
dcf = wb['DCF Valuation']
dcf['K16'] = "=K14*(1+$C$67)/($C$66-$C$67)"

wb.save(out)
print('saved', out)

import openpyxl
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, LineChart, Reference
from openpyxl.chart.axis import ChartLines
from copy import copy

SRC = '/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/08_Project Seafood Model/08_04_Seafood_input.xlsx'
OUT = '/mnt/spreadsheet_output/08_04_output.xlsx'

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(SRC)

# ---------- 1. DCF Valuation: Discounted FCFE for Dec-23..Dec-28 (F20:K20) ----------
dcf = wb['DCF Valuation']
style_src = dcf['E20']
for col in ['F','G','H','I','J','K']:
    cell = dcf[f'{col}20']
    cell.value = f'=+{col}17*{col}19'
    cell._style = copy(style_src._style)

# ---------- 2. Income Statement: Net Margin monthly Aug-23..Dec-28 (P69:CB69) ----------
inc = wb['Income Statement']
style_src = inc['H69']
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter, column_index_from_string
start = column_index_from_string('P')   # Aug-23
end   = column_index_from_string('CB')  # Dec-28
for ci in range(start, end + 1):
    L = get_column_letter(ci)
    cell = inc[f'{L}69']
    cell.value = f'={L}68/{L}$6'
    cell._style = copy(style_src._style)

# ---------- 3. Balance Sheet: Long Term Debt link + Check (monthly Jan-23..Dec-28, I:T) ----------
bs = wb['Balance Sheet']
# Capex sheet monthly columns U..AF = Jan-23..Dec-28; Net Debt row = 131
capex_cols = ['U','V','W','X','Y','Z','AA','AB','AC','AD','AE','AF']
bs_cols = ['I','J','K','L','M','N','O','P','Q','R','S','T']
style_src = bs['I18']
for bc, cc in zip(bs_cols, capex_cols):
    cell = bs[f'{bc}18']
    cell.value = f"='Capex and Debt Assumptions '!{cc}131"
    cell._style = copy(style_src._style)
# Check row 34: Total liabilities and equity (20) - Total Assets (32)
style_src = bs['I20']
for bc in bs_cols:
    cell = bs[f'{bc}34']
    cell.value = f'={bc}20-{bc}32'
    cell._style = copy(style_src._style)

# ---------- 4. Working Capital: monthly interest on WC loan (C68:BV68) ----------
wc = wb['Working Capital']
style_src = wc['C66']
for ci in range(3, 75):  # C..BV
    L = get_column_letter(ci)
    cell = wc[f'{L}68']
    cell.value = f'={L}66*{L}67/12'
    cell._style = copy(style_src._style)

# ---------- 5. Dashboard: combo chart Revenue (bar) + EBITDA Margin (line), FY23-FY28 ----------
dash = wb['Dashboard']
bar = BarChart()
bar.type = 'col'
bar.title = 'Revenue and EBITDA Margin (FY23-FY28)'
bar.y_axis.title = 'Revenue (US$ Mn)'
bar.height = 9
bar.width = 18
data = Reference(dash, min_col=1, min_row=3, max_col=7, max_row=3)
cats = Reference(dash, min_col=2, min_row=2, max_col=7, max_row=2)
bar.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True, from_rows=True)
bar.set_categories(cats)

line = LineChart()
ldata = Reference(dash, min_col=1, min_row=4, max_col=7, max_row=4)
line.add_data(ldata, titles_from_data=True, from_rows=True)
line.y_axis.axId = 200
line.y_axis.title = 'EBITDA Margin'
line.y_axis.majorGridlines = None
bar.y_axis.crosses = 'autoZero'
bar += line
line.y_axis.crosses = 'max'

from openpyxl.drawing.spreadsheet_drawing import OneCellAnchor, AnchorMarker
from openpyxl.drawing.xdr import XDRPositiveSize2D
from openpyxl.utils.units import pixels_to_EMU
marker = AnchorMarker(col=8, colOff=0, row=49, rowOff=0)
size = XDRPositiveSize2D(pixels_to_EMU(520), pixels_to_EMU(280))
bar.anchor = OneCellAnchor(_from=marker, ext=size)
dash.add_chart(bar)

wb.save(OUT)
print('saved', OUT)

import re, zipfile, shutil, os
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

SRC = '/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/08_Project Seafood Model/08_05_Seafood_input.xlsx'
OUT = '/mnt/spreadsheet_output/08_05_output.xlsx'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)

def colL(c): return get_column_letter(c)

# ---- build formula map: sheet file -> {ref: formula} ----
fmap = {f: {} for f in ['sheet1','sheet3','sheet4','sheet6','sheet7']}

# DCF Valuation (sheet1)
fmap['sheet1']['C63'] = 'C60+C62*C61'          # Gross Cost of Equity
fmap['sheet1']['C66'] = 'C63+C64+C65'          # Net Cost of Equity

# Cashflow (sheet4): Closing Balance row 30 = Opening + Net changes
for c in range(3, 81):
    L = colL(c)
    fmap['sheet4'][f'{L}30'] = f'{L}29+{L}28'

# Balance Sheet (sheet3)
for c in range(3, 9):     # annual C..H -> offset equation
    L = colL(c)
    fmap['sheet3'][f'{L}9']  = f'OFFSET($I9,0,{L}$4-1,1,1)'
    fmap['sheet3'][f'{L}16'] = f'OFFSET($I16,0,{L}$4-1,1,1)'
    fmap['sheet3'][f'{L}20'] = f'OFFSET($I20,0,{L}$4-1,1,1)'
for c in range(9, 81):    # monthly I..CB
    L = colL(c)
    fmap['sheet3'][f'{L}9']  = f'{L}7+{L}8'
    fmap['sheet3'][f'{L}16'] = f'SUM({L}12:{L}15)'
    fmap['sheet3'][f'{L}20'] = f'{L}9+{L}16+{L}18'

# Ratio Analysis (sheet6): Debt to Equity row 19 (annual cols C..H)
for c in range(3, 9):
    L = colL(c)
    fmap['sheet6'][f'{L}19'] = f"('Balance Sheet'!{L}18+'Balance Sheet'!{L}13)/'Balance Sheet'!{L}9"

# Working Capital (sheet7): WC Loan row 66, Aug-23 (J) .. Dec-28 (BV)
for c in range(10, 75):
    L = colL(c)
    fmap['sheet7'][f'{L}66'] = f'{L}63*{L}62+{L}65*{L}64'

def esc(f):
    return f.replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r')
names = zin.namelist()

with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        base = os.path.basename(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'xl/calcChain.xml':
            continue  # drop stale calc chain (rebuilt automatically)
        if item.filename == '[Content_Types].xml':
            s = data.decode('utf-8')
            s = re.sub(r'<Override PartName="/xl/calcChain\.xml"[^>]*/>', '', s)
            data = s.encode('utf-8')
        elif item.filename == 'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels':
            s = data.decode('utf-8')
            s = re.sub(r'<Relationship Id="rId21"[^>]*calcChain[^>]*/>', '', s)
            data = s.encode('utf-8')
        elif item.filename == 'xl/workbook.xml':
            s = data.decode('utf-8')
            s = s.replace('<calcPr calcId="191029"/>', '<calcPr calcId="191029" fullCalcOnLoad="1"/>')
            data = s.encode('utf-8')
        elif item.filename.startswith('xl/worksheets/') and base[:-4] in fmap:
            sheet = base[:-4]
            s = data.decode('utf-8')
            n = 0
            for ref, formula in fmap[sheet].items():
                pat = re.compile(r'<c r="%s"((?:\s+s="\d+")?)(\s*/>)' % re.escape(ref))
                new = r'<c r="%s"\1><f>%s</f></c>' % (ref, esc(formula))
                s, k = pat.subn(new, s)
                n += k
                if k != 1:
                    print('WARN', sheet, ref, 'replacements:', k)
            print(sheet, 'formulas written:', n, '/', len(fmap[sheet]))
            data = s.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(item, data)
zin.close()
print('saved', OUT)

def col_letter(n):
    s = ''
    while n:
        n, r = divmod(n - 1, 26)
        s = chr(65 + r) + s
    return s

def col_num(s):
    n = 0
    for ch in s:
        n = n * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return n

# ---------- Consol_annual ----------
annual_cols = [('N','B'),('O','C'),('P','D'),('Q','E'),('R','F'),('S','G'),

import re, shutil, zipfile, os, sys
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

SRC = '/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/08_Project Seafood Model/08_02_Seafood_input.xlsx'
OUT = '/mnt/spreadsheet_output/08_02_output.xlsx'

import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(SRC, data_only=True)
cap = wb['Capex and Debt Assumptions ']
ppe_vals = [cap.cell(row=125, column=c).value for c in range(21, 93)]   # U125:CN125
debt_vals = [cap.cell(row=131, column=c).value for c in range(21, 93)]  # U131:CN131
ism = wb['Income Statement']
ebitda_m = [ism.cell(row=55, column=c).value for c in range(3, 9)]      # C55:H55
wc = wb['Working Capital']
r50 = [wc.cell(row=50, column=c).value for c in range(10, 75)]          # J50:BV50
r51 = [wc.cell(row=51, column=c).value for c in range(10, 75)]          # J51:BV51
wb.close()

def fmt(v):
    if v is None:
        return '0'
    return repr(float(v))

def set_cell(row_xml, ref, style, inner):
    """Replace empty cell <c ref=... s=.../> with populated cell, keeping order."""
    pat = re.compile(r'<c r="%s"( [^>/]*)?/>' % ref)
    new = '<c r="%s"%s>%s</c>' % (ref, style, inner)
    out, n = pat.subn(new, row_xml, count=1)
    if n != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('cell %s not found as empty self-closing' % ref)
    return out

def get_row(xml, r):
    m = re.search(r'(<row r="%d"[^>]*>)(.*?)(</row>)' % r, xml, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise RuntimeError('row %d not found' % r)
    return m

# ---------- read sheet xmls from source zip ----------
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
sheets = {n: zin.read('xl/worksheets/' + n).decode('utf-8')
          for n in ['sheet3.xml', 'sheet6.xml', 'sheet7.xml', 'sheet8.xml']}
workbook_xml = zin.read('xl/workbook.xml').decode('utf-8')
rels_xml = zin.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels').decode('utf-8')
ct_xml = zin.read('[Content_Types].xml').decode('utf-8')

# ---------- Balance Sheet (sheet3.xml): rows 18 (LTD) & 23 (PP&E), cols I..CB ----------
x = sheets['sheet3.xml']
for row, vals, src_row, style in [(18, debt_vals, 131, ' s="144"'), (23, ppe_vals, 125, ' s="145"')]:
    m = get_row(x, row)
    body = m.group(2)
    for i in range(72):
        col = get_column_letter(9 + i)          # I..CB
        capcol = get_column_letter(21 + i)      # U..CN
        f = "'Capex and Debt Assumptions '!%s%d" % (capcol, src_row)
        body = set_cell(body, '%s%d' % (col, row), style,
                        '<f>%s</f><v>%s</v>' % (f, fmt(vals[i])))
    x = x[:m.start()] + m.group(1) + body + m.group(3) + x[m.end():]
sheets['sheet3.xml'] = x

# ---------- Assumptions - Line 01 (sheet8.xml): row 6, cols L..CE ----------
dist = [0.08, 0.095, 0.105, 0.095, 0.065, 0.07, 0.07, 0.07, 0.085, 0.09, 0.09, 0.085]
x = sheets['sheet8.xml']
m = get_row(x, 6)
body = m.group(2)
for i in range(72):                              # L..CE (12..83)
    col = get_column_letter(12 + i)
    ref = '%s6' % col
    if i < 24:                                   # L..AI hardcoded (Jan-23..Dec-24)

x = x[:m.start()] + m.group(1) + body + m.group(3) + x[m.end():]

# EBITDA Margin (row 55)

WC_C0, WC_C1 = 10, 74        # J .. BV (Aug-23 .. Dec-28)
for c in range(WC_C0, WC_C1 + 1):

    cell = wc.cell(46, c)
    cell.value = f'={L}44+{L}45'
    style_from(wc, f'{L}50', cell)
    # Receivables net of 70% bills discounting (row 47)
    cell = wc.cell(47, c)
    cell.value = f'={L}9+{L}18+{L}29+{L}38-{L}57'
    style_from(wc, f'{L}50', cell)

    tv = r14[-1]*(1+g)/(re_-g)
    return tot + tv/((1+re_)**r18[-1])

        else: a,fa=m,fm

def recalc(path, tag):
    d = f'/tmp/rc_{tag}'

    subprocess.run(['soffice', '--headless', '--convert-to', 'xlsx', '--outdir', d, path],

def irr_of(re_, g):
    """IRR (consecutive periods 0..8) of the recomputed discounted FCFE row."""
    flows = list(r14)
    flows[8] = r14[8] + r14[8] * (1 + g) / (re_ - g)          # terminal value at growth g
    disc = [f / ((1 + re_) ** t) for f, t in zip(flows, r18)]  # discount at cost of equity
    def f(q):
        return sum(v / (1 + q) ** i for i, v in enumerate(disc))
    lo, hi = -0.999999, 10.0
    flo = f(lo)
    for _ in range(200):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        fm = f(mid)
        if flo * fm <= 0:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo, flo = mid, fm
    return (lo + hi) / 2

        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        fm = f(mid)
        if flo * fm <= 0: hi = mid
        else: lo, flo = mid, fm
    return (lo + hi) / 2

EPOCH = datetime.datetime(1899, 12, 30)
def to_serial(v):
    if isinstance(v, datetime.datetime):
        return (v - EPOCH).total_seconds() / 86400.0
    if isinstance(v, datetime.date):
        return (datetime.datetime.combine(v, datetime.time()) - EPOCH).total_seconds() / 86400.0
    return v

    sheetmap[tgt] = sh.get('name')

def fmt_num(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return '1' if v else '0'
    if isinstance(v, float) and v == int(v) and abs(v) < 1e15:
        return str(int(v))
    return repr(v)

content = {}

    data = zin.read(tgt)
    root = etree.fromstring(data)
    vals = wbv[name]
    n = 0
    for cell in root.iter(f'{{{NS}}}c'):
        f_el = cell.find(f'{{{NS}}}f')
        if f_el is None:

        coord = cell.get('r')
        v = vals[coord].value
        if v is None or v == '':
            continue
        v = to_serial(v)
        for old in cell.findall(f'{{{NS}}}v'):
            cell.remove(old)
        ve = etree.SubElement(cell, f'{{{NS}}}v')
        if isinstance(v, bool):
            cell.set('t', 'b'); ve.text = '1' if v else '0'
        elif isinstance(v, (int, float)):
            if 't' in cell.attrib: del cell.attrib['t']
            ve.text = fmt_num(v)
        else:
            s = str(v)
            if s.startswith('#'):
                cell.set('t', 'e')
            else:
                cell.set('t', 'str')
            ve.text = s
        n += 1
    content[tgt] = etree.tostring(root, xml_declaration=True, encoding='UTF-8', standalone=True)
    print(f'cached values injected in {name}: {n}')

    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()

import openpyxl, re
from openpyxl.worksheet.formula import ArrayFormula
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/10_Debugging/input_files/Inconsistent Color Coding_input.xlsx')

def color_key(font):
    c = font.color
    if c is None: return 'none'
    if c.type == 'rgb': return str(c.rgb)
    if c.type == 'theme': return 'T%s'%c.theme
    return str(c)

def classify(cell):
    v = cell.value
    if isinstance(v, ArrayFormula): v = v.text
    if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith('='):
        s = v[1:].strip()
        if re.fullmatch(r"(?:'[^']+'|[A-Za-z0-9_]+!)?\$?[A-Z]{1,3}\$?[0-9]+(?::\$?[A-Z]{1,3}\$?[0-9]+)?", s):
            return 'R'
        return 'F'
    if isinstance(v, str): return 't'
    return 'n'

ws = wb['Model']
with open('/tmp/model_dump.txt','w') as f:
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            if cell.value is None: continue
            v = cell.value
            if isinstance(v, ArrayFormula): v = v.text
            f.write(f"{cell.coordinate}\t{classify(cell)}\t{color_key(cell.font)}\t{repr(v)[:90]}\n")
print("done")

import openpyxl
src='/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/06_Debugging/input_files/Embedded Hardcodes_input.xlsx'
out='/mnt/spreadsheet_output/06_02_output.xlsx'
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(src)

def setv(sheet,cell,val):
    wb[sheet][cell]=val
    print('set',sheet,cell,'=',val)

# --- DCF: replace embedded hardcodes with proper formulas/links ---
setv('DCF','E4','=WACC!C25')                       # WACC hardcoded; matches Gordon side (J4)
setv('DCF','E5',"='Comps + Beta'!H32")             # Adjusted EV/EBIT multiple from comps
setv('DCF','E14',"='Dilution'!F16")                # Diluted shares outstanding
setv('DCF','J14','=E14')                           # mirror multiples-method shares
setv('DCF','J6',"='Operating Model'!S32*(1+J5)/(J4-J5)")  # Gordon Growth TV (was hardcode 5928.72)
setv('DCF','M19','=WACC!C25')                      # sensitivity axis WACC
setv('DCF','M37','=WACC!C25')                      # sensitivity axis WACC
setv('DCF','T12','=J5')                            # sensitivity axis PGR
setv('DCF','T30','=E5')                            # sensitivity axis EV/EBIT

# --- PTA: duplicated hardcodes & broken references ---
setv('PTA','R24','=H17')                           # Median EV/EBIT multiple (label existed, cell blank)
setv('PTA','R25',"='Operating Model'!S23*PTA!R24") # TV = EBIT x multiple (was revenue x multiple)
setv('PTA','R33','=DCF!E14')                       # diluted shares
setv('PTA','R37','=DCF!E18')                       # current price

# --- Operating Model ---
setv('Operating Model','D26','=Cover!G8')          # statutory tax rate
for c in ['J','K','L']:                            # sign consistency with M:S taxes
    setv('Operating Model',c+'25','= -IF(%s23>0,$D$26*%s23,0)'%(c,c))

# --- Revenue Build ---
setv('Revenue Build','S9','=SUM(S13,S21)')         # was '=S13' (excluded Legacy Durham)

# --- Supporting Schedules ---
setv('Supporting Schedules','K20','=J20')          # DIO hardcode broke the chain

# --- WACC ---
setv('WACC','C14','=Cover!G8')
setv('WACC','F14','=Cover!G8')
setv('WACC','C17',"='Comps + Beta'!D21")           # market value of equity

# --- Comps + Beta ---
setv('Comps + Beta','C32','=Cover!G8')

wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad=True
wb.save(out)
print('saved',out)

import openpyxl, shutil
src='/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/08_Debugging/input_files/Relative vs Absolute References_input.xlsx'
out='/mnt/spreadsheet_output/08_09_output.xlsx'
shutil.copy(src,out)
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(out)
om=wb['Operating Model + DCF']
rb=wb['Revenue Build']

# 1) Gross margin case selection (row 41): broken relative refs to E41/F41/G41 -> absolute $D$41
for col in ['N','O','P','Q','S','T','U','V']:
    om[f'{col}41'] = f'=OFFSET({col}41,$D$41,0)'

# 2) Broken reference typo R847 -> R83
om['R84'] = '=R83-M83'

# 3) Broken year header Q66 referencing O66 instead of P66
om['Q66'] = '=P66+0'

# 4) Inconsistent ratio denominators (used COGS row 7/total instead of revenue row 4)
om['M27'] = '=M26/M4'
om['R27'] = '=R26/R4'

# 5) Discount factors used absolute $C$97 (period 1) for every year -> relative period per column
for col in ['C','D','E','F','G','H']:
    om[f'{col}99'] = f'=(1+{col}98)^{col}97'

# 6) SG&A case rows in Revenue Build (row 29): mixed relative refs E$29/F$29/G$29 -> $D$29
for col in ['S','T','U','V','X','Y','Z','AA']:
    rb[f'{col}29'] = f'=OFFSET({col}29,$D$29,0)'

# 7) WACC hardcoded in DCF -> link to Comps + WACC (same value, better practice)
for col in ['C','D','E','F','G','H']:
    om[f'{col}98'] = "='Comps + WACC'!$C$38"

wb.save(out)
print('saved')

# 5. Monthly: Prestige Financing investment recognition at commencement

import copy

def fill_row(ws, row, start_col, end_col, formula_tpl, style_col):
    """Fill formula_tpl formatted with column letter, copying style from style_col cell."""
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row, c)
        cell.value = formula_tpl.format(col=get_column_letter(c))
        src = ws.cell(row, style_col)
        cell._style = copy.copy(src._style)
        if src.has_style:
            cell.font = copy.copy(src.font)
            cell.fill = copy.copy(src.fill)
            cell.border = copy.copy(src.border)
            cell.number_format = src.number_format
            cell.alignment = copy.copy(src.alignment)

# ---------------- Income Statement ----------------
isw = wb["Income Statement"]
# EBITDA monthly Aug-23 (P=16) .. Dec-28 (CB=80): same pattern as O column

# EBITDA Margin already P..CB; Net margin already P..CB
# Tax: 30% flat, nil if PBT negative
fill_row(isw, 66, 16, 80, "=IF({col}64<0,0,{col}64*'Assumptions - Company Level'!$C$8)", 15)

# redo with proper style source from existing neighbors of similar rows
def fill_row2(ws, row, start_col, end_col, formula_tpl, style_row, style_col):
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row, c)
        cell.value = formula_tpl.format(col=get_column_letter(c))
        src = ws.cell(style_row, style_col)
        cell.font = copy.copy(src.font)
        cell.fill = copy.copy(src.fill)
        cell.border = copy.copy(src.border)
        cell.number_format = src.number_format
        cell.alignment = copy.copy(src.alignment)

fill_row2(wc, 46, 10, 74, "=SUM({col}44:{col}45)", 44, 10)          # Inventory = FG + RM
fill_row2(wc, 47, 10, 74, "={col}9+{col}18+{col}29+{col}38", 9, 10) # Receivables (all lines)
fill_row2(wc, 48, 10, 74, "={col}11+{col}20+{col}31+{col}40", 11, 10) # Payables
# NWC as % of Revenue monthly (Working Capital col c -> Income Statement col c+6)
for c in range(10, 75):

    cell.fill = copy.copy(src.fill)
    cell.border = copy.copy(src.border)

    cell.alignment = copy.copy(src.alignment)

# ---------------- Balance Sheet ----------------

    cell = bs.cell(28, c)

# Assets = Liabilities check
fill_row2(bs, 34, 9, 80, "={col}32-{col}20", 32, 9)

# ---------------- DCF Valuation ----------------

    L=openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(col)
    c=fin.cell(row=19,column=col)
    c.value=f'={L}17/{L}$5'
    c.number_format='0.0%'

asm=wb['Assumptions']
# D&A forecast K59:O59 = sales * % of revenue (row61)

val=wb['Valuation']

for i,off in enumerate(wacc_off):

import openpyxl

SRC = '/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/01_bond_accounting/01_07_input.xlsx'
DST = '/mnt/spreadsheet_output/01_07_output.xlsx'

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(SRC)
ws = wb.active

# ---- Solve implied IRR (semiannual), 6 coupon periods + face repayment ----
def f(r):
    return 31350 - sum(900/(1+r)**t for t in range(1, 7)) - 30000/(1+r)**6

lo, hi = 1e-6, 0.5
for _ in range(300):
    mid = (lo + hi) / 2
    if f(mid) < 0:
        lo = mid
    else:
        hi = mid
r = (lo + hi) / 2

# ---- Build effective-interest (amortized cost) schedule ----
cols = ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H']          # 6 coupon periods
bop = 31350.0
amort, iexp, eop = {}, {}, {}
for c in cols:
    ie = bop * r
    a = ie - 900.0                              # amortization of premium (negative)
    e = bop + a
    iexp[c], amort[c], eop[c] = ie, a, e
    bop = e
assert abs(eop['H'] - 30000.0) < 1e-6

tax = 0.35
def setv(coord, val):
    ws[coord] = val

# L12: Implied IRR (discount rate), per period
setv('L12', r)

# Row 7: Interest expense (amortization)  (I7 already 0)
for c in cols:
    setv(f'{c}7', amort[c])

# Row 8: Interest expense (coupon) -> maturity period has no coupon
setv('I8', 0)

# Row 9: Pretax profit = revenue - expenses - total GAAP interest (amortization + coupon)
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    setv(f'{c}9', ws[f'{c}5'].value - ws[f'{c}6'].value - ws[f'{c}7'].value - ws[f'{c}8'].value)

# Row 10: GAAP tax expense = pretax profit * tax rate
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    setv(f'{c}10', ws[f'{c}9'].value * tax)

# Row 11: Cash taxes due = (revenue - expenses - coupon interest) * tax rate
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    setv(f'{c}11', (ws[f'{c}5'].value - ws[f'{c}6'].value - ws[f'{c}8'].value) * tax)

# Row 12: Deferred taxes = GAAP tax expense - cash taxes due
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    setv(f'{c}12', ws[f'{c}10'].value - ws[f'{c}11'].value)

# ---- GAAP Balance Sheet ----
prev_eop = 31350.0
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    setv(f'{c}16', prev_eop)                    # Loan balance - BOP
    chg = amort[c] if c in amort else -30000.0  # Change = amortization; maturity repays face
    setv(f'{c}17', chg)
    prev_eop = prev_eop + chg
    setv(f'{c}18', prev_eop)                    # Loan balance - EOP
assert abs(ws['I18'].value) < 1e-6

# ---- Deferred tax assets (none arise; given zeros) ----
setv('I21', 0)                                  # Change in DTAs at maturity
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    b = 0 if c == 'C' else ws[{  # BOP = prior EOP
        'D': 'C', 'E': 'D', 'F': 'E', 'G': 'F', 'H': 'G', 'I': 'H'}[c] + '22'].value
    setv(f'{c}20', b)
    setv(f'{c}21', ws[f'{c}21'].value if ws[f'{c}21'].value is not None else 0)
    setv(f'{c}22', b + ws[f'{c}21'].value)

# ---- Deferred tax liabilities ----
prev = 0.0
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    setv(f'{c}24', prev)                        # DTL - BOP
    chg = ws[f'{c}12'].value                    # Change in DTLs = deferred taxes
    setv(f'{c}25', chg)
    prev = prev + chg
    setv(f'{c}26', prev)                        # DTL - EOP

# ---- Tax B/S impact of borrowing ----
# Change in cash from the borrowing: proceeds, coupons, principal repayment
setv('C29', 31350.0)
for c in ['D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H']:
    setv(f'{c}29', -900.0)
setv('I29', -30000.0)

# Loan balance (tax basis = face)
prev = 30000.0
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    setv(f'{c}31', prev)                        # BOP
    chg = ws[f'{c}32'].value if ws[f'{c}32'].value is not None else 0
    if c == 'I':
        chg = -30000.0
        setv('I32', chg)
    prev = prev + chg
    setv(f'{c}33', prev)                        # EOP
assert abs(ws['I33'].value) < 1e-6

# Retained earnings (only extinguishment effects; carrying = face at maturity -> no loss)
prev = 0.0
for c in ['C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H', 'I']:
    setv(f'{c}35', prev)                        # BOP
    chg = ws[f'{c}36'].value if ws[f'{c}36'].value is not None else 0

# cash

ocf={c:g(8,c) for c in cols}
beg_cash={2:450}
end_debt={'rev':{},'tla':{},'tlb':{}}
rates={'rev':15,'tla':22,'tlb':29}
begb={'rev':12,'tla':19,'tlb':26}
rep_row={'rev':13,'tla':20,'tlb':27}
end_row={'rev':14,'tla':21,'tlb':28}
int_row={'rev':16,'tla':23,'tlb':30}
avail_row={'rev':17,'tla':24}
order=['rev','tla','tlb']
for c in cols:
    if c>2: beg_cash[c]=req[cols[cols.index(c)-1]]
    ws.cell(row=6,column=c).value=beg_cash[c]
    ws.cell(row=9,column=c).value=beg_cash[c]-req[c]+ocf[c]
    cash=ws.cell(row=9,column=c).value
    for i,d in enumerate(order):
        b=ws.cell(row=begb[d],column=c).value
        if c>2: b=end_debt[d][cols[cols.index(c)-1]]

        rep=-min(b,cash)

        e=b+rep
        ws.cell(row=end_row[d],column=c).value=e
        interest=(b+e)/2*rates[d]

        if i<2: ws.cell(row=avail_row[d],column=c).value=cash
    ws.cell(row=33,column=c).value=end_debt['rev'][c]+end_debt['tla'][c]+end_debt['tlb'][c]
    ws.cell(row=34,column=c).value=sum(ws.cell(row=int_row[d],column=c).value for d in order)
    ws.cell(row=35,column=c).value=req[c]

    ws[f'{col}20']=30                                     # Debt
ws['D21']=60; ws['E21']=60; ws['F21']=0                   # Deferred revenue
for col in ('D','E','F'):

SRC = '/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/06_equity_forecast/06_12_input.xlsx'

# Column map: I=Q1 2025E, J=Q2 2025E, K=Q3 2025E, L=Q4 2025E, M=2025E, N=2026E
q_cols = ['I', 'J', 'K', 'L']

# --- Row 9: Net Income (from assumptions C18:C21, C22) ---
ni_assums = ['$C$18', '$C$19', '$C$20', '$C$21']
for col, a in zip(q_cols, ni_assums):
    ws[f'{col}9'] = f'={a}'
ws['M9'] = '=SUM(I9:L9)'
ws['N9'] = '=$C$22'

# --- Row 11: D&A (assumption per quarter C24 for 2025E; C25 for 2026E) ---
for col in q_cols:
    ws[f'{col}11'] = '=$C$24'
ws['M11'] = '=SUM(I11:L11)'
ws['N11'] = '=$C$25*4'

# --- Row 12: Changes in Working Capital = % of revenue growth (period-appropriate) ---
prev = {'I': 'G10', 'J': 'I10', 'K': 'J10', 'L': 'K10'}
for col in q_cols:
    ws[f'{col}12'] = f'=$C$27*({col}10-{prev[col]})'
ws['M12'] = '=SUM(I12:L12)'
ws['N12'] = '=$C$27*(N10-M10)'

# --- Row 13: Deferred Taxes & Other (C29:C32 for 2025E quarters; C33 per quarter 2026E) ---
dt_assums = ['$C$29', '$C$30', '$C$31', '$C$32']
for col, a in zip(q_cols, dt_assums):
    ws[f'{col}13'] = f'={a}'
ws['M13'] = '=SUM(I13:L13)'
ws['N13'] = '=$C$33*4'

# --- Row 14: Cash from Operations = Net Income + D&A + WC change + Deferred Taxes ---
for col in q_cols:
    ws[f'{col}14'] = f'={col}9+{col}11+{col}12+{col}13'
ws['M14'] = '=SUM(I14:L14)'
ws['N14'] = '=N9+N11+N12+N13'

# Match number formatting of the historical value cells in these rows
for r in [9, 11, 12, 13, 14]:
    for col in ['I', 'J', 'K', 'L', 'M', 'N']:
        ws[f'{col}{r}'].number_format = '0.0'

wb.save(DST)
print('saved', DST)

import openpyxl

SRC = '/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/06_equity_forecast/06_17_input.xlsx'
OUT = '/mnt/spreadsheet_output/06_17_output.xlsx'

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(SRC)
ws = wb['OpEx_Forecast']

# --- Forecast Assumptions ---
# R&D % of Revenue: Q4 2021 (E13/D13 = 88/606 = 14.5215%) rounded to 1dp -> 14.5%
ws['C25'] = '=ROUND(E13/D13,3)'          # 0.145 -> 14.5%
ws['C25'].number_format = '0.0%'
# SG&A normalizes to 10.0%
ws['C26'] = 0.10
ws['C26'].number_format = '0.0%'

# --- Forecast rows 14-21 ---
for r in range(14, 22):
    ws[f'E{r}'] = f'=D{r}*$C$25'   # R&D = Revenue * 14.5%
    ws[f'F{r}'] = f'=D{r}*$C$26'   # SG&A = Revenue * 10.0%
    ws[f'G{r}'] = f'=E{r}+F{r}'    # Total OpEx (same pattern as historical rows)
    ws[f'H{r}'] = f'=D{r}-G{r}'    # Operating Income

# --- Key Metrics (Q4 2021 = row 13, Q4 2022 = row 17, Q4 2023 = row 21) ---
metrics = {30: 'E', 31: 'F', 32: 'G', 33: 'H'}  # table column per metric row
cols = {'C': 13, 'D': 17, 'E': 21}              # metric column -> table row
for mr, col in metrics.items():
    for mc, tr in cols.items():
        cell = ws[f'{mc}{mr}']
        cell.value = f'={col}{tr}/D{tr}'
        cell.number_format = '0.0%'

wb.save(OUT)
print('saved', OUT)

s(15,3,"=C9*C8")                         # Equity income = 30% * 180 = 54
s(18,3,"=C15*(1-C7)*C6")                 # Deferred tax expense: DTL = 54*(1-75%)*38% = 5.13
s(17,3,"=C14*C6")                        # Cash taxes = 1070*38% = 406.60
s(16,3,"=C17+C18")                       # Total income taxes = 411.73
s(19,3,"=C14+C15-C16")                   # Net income = 712.27

# Balance sheet Part 1: C=1/1/2018, D=(+/-), E... actually D=12/31/2018? col3=(+/-), col4=12/31
s(24,3,"=C15")                           # Investment: +equity income
s(25,3,0)                                # Other assets: no change
s(30,3,"=C19")                           # SE: +NI
s(29,3,"=C18")                           # DTL: +5.13
s(23,3,"=C30+D30+C29+D29-C24-D24-C25-D25")  # Cash = plug so BS balances = 663.40
for r in (23,24,25):
    s(r,4,f"=C{r}+D{r}")
s(26,4,"=SUM(C23:C25)")
s(31,4,"=SUM(C28:C30)")

s(39,3,"=C38*(1-C36)*C35")               # Cash tax on dividends = 180*(1-75%)*38% = 17.10

s(48,3,"=C18")                           # Deferred tax benefit = reversal of DTL = 5.13

s(59,6,"=-C18")                          # DTL -5.13

for r in (53,54,55):
    s(r,5,f"=C{r}+D{r}")
    s(r,7,f"=E{r}+F{r}") if False else None
# fix: 12/31/2018 is col5? header row52: B blank,C='1/1/2018',D='(+/-) 2018',E='12/31/2018',F='(+/-) 2019',G='12/31/2019'
for r in (53,54,55):

import openpyxl
p="/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/13_nonrecurring/13_03_input.xlsx"
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p); ws=wb["FinancialNormalization"]
rev=[320,352,378,408]; cogs=[166,180,195,210]; sa=[48,53,58,62]; tax=[20,23,24,28]
# normalize
ncogs=cogs[:]; ncogs[1]-=25; ncogs[2]-=32
nsa=sa[:]; nsa[3]+=20
shield=[0,25*0.21,32*0.21,-20*0.21]
ntax=[tax[i]-shield[i] for i in range(4)]
nrev=rev[:]
int_=10
ebt=[nrev[i]-ncogs[i]-nsa[i]-int_ for i in range(4)]
ni=[ebt[i]-ntax[i] for i in range(4)]
# metrics historical
growth=[None]+[rev[i]/rev[i-1]-1 for i in range(1,4)]
gm=[(nrev[i]-ncogs[i])/nrev[i] for i in range(4)]
sam=[nsa[i]/nrev[i] for i in range(4)]
tr=[ntax[i]/ebt[i] for i in range(4)]
# forecast avg of prior 3 quarters (Q2-Q4 2024)
g=sum(growth[1:])/3; G=sum(gm[1:])/3; S=sum(sam[1:])/3; T=sum(tr[1:])/3
f_rev=[rev[3]*(1+g), rev[3]*(1+g)**2]
f_cogs=[r*(1-G) for r in f_rev]
f_sa=[r*S for r in f_rev]
f_ebt=[f_rev[i]-f_cogs[i]-f_sa[i]-int_ for i in range(2)]
f_tax=[e*T for e in f_ebt]
f_ni=[f_ebt[i]-f_tax[i] for i in range(2)]
R=nrev+f_rev; C=ncogs+f_cogs; A=nsa+f_sa; E=[nrev[i]-ncogs[i] for i in range(4)]+[f_rev[i]-f_cogs[i] for i in range(2)]
EBIT=[R[i]-C[i]-A[i] for i in range(6)]
EBT=[EBIT[i]-int_ for i in range(6)]
TX=ntax+f_tax; NI=ni+f_ni
GR=[None]+[R[i]/R[i-1]-1 for i in range(1,6)]
GMm=[(R[i]-C[i])/R[i] for i in range(6)]
SM=[A[i]/R[i] for i in range(6)]
TM=[TX[i]/EBT[i] for i in range(6)]
EPS=[NI[i]/175 for i in range(6)]
def put(row,vals,start=2):
    for j,v in enumerate(vals):
        if v is not None: ws.cell(row=row,column=start+j,value=v)
put(25,R); put(26,C); put(27,E); put(28,A); put(29,EBIT); put(30,[int_]*6); put(31,EBT); put(32,TX); put(33,NI)
put(38,GR); put(39,GMm); put(40,SM); put(41,TM); put(42,EPS)
wb.save("/mnt/spreadsheet_output/13_03_output.xlsx")
for i in range(6): print(round(R[i],2),round(C[i],2),round(A[i],2),round(EBT[i],2),round(TX[i],2),round(NI[i],2),round(EPS[i],3))

import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/14_re_dcf/14_05_input.xlsx')
ws = wb['NOI_Projection']
for y in range(5):
    r = 35+y
    if y==0:
        ws[f'C{r}'] = '=B22'
        ws[f'D{r}'] = '=B23'
        ws[f'E{r}'] = '=B24'
        ws[f'F{r}'] = '=B25'
        ws[f'J{r}'] = '=-B28'
        ws[f'K{r}'] = '=-B29'
        ws[f'L{r}'] = '=-B30'
    else:
        p = r-1
        ws[f'C{r}'] = f'=C{p}*(1+$B$10)'
        ws[f'D{r}'] = f'=D{p}*(1+$B$11)'
        ws[f'E{r}'] = f'=E{p}*(1+$B$11)'
        ws[f'F{r}'] = f'=F{p}*(1+$B$11)'
        ws[f'J{r}'] = f'=J{p}*(1+$B$12)'
        ws[f'K{r}'] = f'=K{p}*(1+$B$13)'
        ws[f'L{r}'] = f'=L{p}*(1+$B$14)'
    ws[f'G{r}'] = f'=SUM(C{r}:F{r})'
    ws[f'H{r}'] = f'=-G{r}*$B$17'
    ws[f'I{r}'] = f'=G{r}+H{r}'
    ws[f'M{r}'] = f'=-I{r}*$B$18'
    ws[f'N{r}'] = f'=SUM(J{r}:M{r})'
    ws[f'O{r}'] = f'=I{r}+N{r}'
wb.save('/mnt/spreadsheet_output/14_05_output.xlsx')

price = 112_000_000
units = 350
sf = units*900
rate = 0.0625
r = rate/12
term = 120
amort = 360
io = 24
noi1 = 6_200_000
g = 0.03
dscr_min = 1.25
dy_min = 0.085
ltv = 0.75

# Loan sizing
L_ltv = price*ltv
pay_factor = r/(1-(1+r)**-amort)   # monthly payment per $1
L_dscr = noi1/dscr_min/(12*pay_factor)
L_dy = noi1/dy_min
L_max = min(L_ltv, L_dscr, L_dy)
print(f"L_ltv  = {L_ltv:,.2f}  per unit {L_ltv/units:,.2f} per sf {L_ltv/sf:,.2f}")
print(f"L_dscr = {L_dscr:,.2f}  per unit {L_dscr/units:,.2f} per sf {L_dscr/sf:,.2f}")
print(f"L_dy   = {L_dy:,.2f}  per unit {L_dy/units:,.2f} per sf {L_dy/sf:,.2f}")
print(f"L_max  = {L_max:,.2f}  per unit {L_max/units:,.2f} per sf {L_max/sf:,.2f}")

# Debt service on max loan
io_m = L_max*r; io_a = io_m*12
am_m = L_max*pay_factor; am_a = am_m*12
print(f"IO monthly = {io_m:,.2f}  annual = {io_a:,.2f}")
print(f"AM monthly = {am_m:,.2f}  annual = {am_a:,.2f}")

# Balance at maturity: 24 months IO + 96 amortizing payments on 360-mo schedule
k = term - io  # 96
bal = L_max*((1+r)**amort - (1+r)**k)/((1+r)**amort - 1)
# cross-check via iterative amortization
bal2 = L_max
for _ in range(k):
    bal2 = bal2*(1+r) - am_m
print(f"Balance at maturity (closed form) = {bal:,.2f}")
print(f"Balance at maturity (iterative)   = {bal2:,.2f}")

# DSCR coverage
noi2 = noi1*(1+g)
print(f"DSCR IO  Y1 = {noi1/io_a:.4f}   Y2+ = {noi2/io_a:.4f}")
print(f"DSCR AM  Y1 = {noi1/am_a:.4f}   Y2+ = {noi2/am_a:.4f}")

import shutil, datetime
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.chart import LineChart, Reference
from openpyxl.chart.data_source import AxDataSource, MultiLevelStrRef, MultiLevelStrData, Level, StrVal, NumDataSource, NumRef, StrRef
from openpyxl.chart.series import Series, SeriesLabel
from openpyxl.chart.marker import Marker

SRC = "/mnt/spreadsheet_data/spreadsheet/Task 1420776/Task 1420776_input.xlsx"
OUT = "/mnt/spreadsheet_output/Task 1420776_output.xlsx"

shutil.copy(SRC, OUT)
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(OUT)

feb = wb["Feb24"]
mar = wb["Mar24"]

# Collect data Feb 8 - Mar 8 inclusive
records = []  # (date, day, time, sys, dia, pulse, sugar)
for row in range(3, 32):  # Feb24 data rows (Feb 1-29)
    d = feb.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    if isinstance(d, datetime.datetime) and datetime.date(2024, 2, 8) <= d.date() <= datetime.date(2024, 2, 29):
        records.append([d.date(),
                        feb.cell(row=row, column=3).value,
                        feb.cell(row=row, column=4).value,
                        feb.cell(row=row, column=5).value,
                        feb.cell(row=row, column=6).value,
                        feb.cell(row=row, column=7).value])
for row in range(3, 34):  # Mar24 data rows
    d = mar.cell(row=row, column=1).value
    if isinstance(d, datetime.datetime) and datetime.date(2024, 3, 1) <= d.date() <= datetime.date(2024, 3, 8):
        records.append([d.date(),
                        mar.cell(row=row, column=3).value,
                        mar.cell(row=row, column=4).value,
                        mar.cell(row=row, column=5).value,
                        mar.cell(row=row, column=6).value,
                        mar.cell(row=row, column=7).value])

records.sort(key=lambda r: r[0])
assert len(records) == 30, len(records)
assert records[0][0] == datetime.date(2024, 2, 8) and records[-1][0] == datetime.date(2024, 3, 8)

# Create consolidated sheet
if "Consolidated" in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb["Consolidated"]
ws = wb.create_sheet("Consolidated")

headers = ["date", "day", "time", "Systolic", "Diastolic", "Pulse", "Sugar"]
for c, h in enumerate(headers, start=1):
    ws.cell(row=1, column=c, value=h)

r = 2
for rec in records:
    d = rec[0]
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=f"{d.strftime('%b')} {d.day}")          # date (text)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=d.strftime("%a"))                        # day of week
    if rec[1] is not None:
        t = rec[1]
        ws.cell(row=r, column=3, value=f"{t.hour:02d}:{t.minute:02d}")      # time (text)
    for i, v in enumerate(rec[2:], start=4):
        if v is None:
            ws.cell(row=r, column=i, value="=NA()")   # missing -> #N/A -> gap in line
        else:
            ws.cell(row=r, column=i, value=v)
    r += 1

last_row = r - 1  # 31

# widths for readability
for col, w in zip("ABCDEFG", [10, 8, 8, 10, 10, 8, 8]):
    ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

# ---- Build line chart ----
chart = LineChart()
chart.title = "Measurements Feb 8 - Mar 8, 2024"
chart.style = 2
chart.y_axis.title = "Value"
chart.x_axis.title = "Date / Day / Time"
chart.x_axis.delete = False
chart.y_axis.delete = False
chart.height = 12
chart.width = 32  # wide so the date labels have space and do not overlap
try:
    chart.displayBlanksAs = "gap"
except Exception:
    pass

series_names = ["Systolic", "Diastolic", "Pulse", "Sugar"]
for i, name in enumerate(series_names):
    col = 4 + i
    values = Reference(ws, min_col=col, min_row=2, max_col=col, max_row=last_row)
    ser = Series(val=NumDataSource(numRef=NumRef(f=values)))
    ser.tx = SeriesLabel(strRef=StrRef(f"'Consolidated'!${ws.cell(row=1, column=col).coordinate}"))
    ser.idx = i
    ser.order = i
    ser.smooth = False
    ser.marker = Marker(symbol="circle", size=5)
    chart.series.append(ser)

# Multi-level categories: date (A), day (B), time (C) -> 3-level axis
n = last_row - 1  # 30 points
date_vals = [ws.cell(row=i, column=1).value for i in range(2, last_row + 1)]
day_vals = [ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value for i in range(2, last_row + 1)]
time_vals = [ws.cell(row=i, column=3).value for i in range(2, last_row + 1)]

def lvl_from(vals):
    pts = [StrVal(idx=i, v=str(v)) for i, v in enumerate(vals) if v not in (None, "")]
    return Level(pt=pts)

cache = MultiLevelStrData(ptCount=n,
                          lvl=[lvl_from(time_vals),   # innermost level first
                               lvl_from(day_vals),
                               lvl_from(date_vals)])  # outermost level last
mlref = MultiLevelStrRef(f=f"Consolidated!$A$2:$C${last_row}", multiLvlStrCache=cache)
axds = AxDataSource(multiLvlStrRef=mlref)
for ser in chart.series:
    ser.cat = axds

# keep tick labels on every category, positioned low so they don't collide with the plot
chart.x_axis.tickLblSkip = 1
chart.x_axis.tickMarkSkip = 1
chart.x_axis.tickLblPos = "low"

ws.add_chart(chart, "I2")
wb.save(OUT)
print("saved", OUT)
